annotations.title: Status of a 3D picture job (solar roof check)

description: Where a roof_picture_start job is: rendering (poll again in 10 seconds), done (with the view, size and plan code), failed (with a reason code: plan_error, render_error, render_lost) or unknown (wrong or expired job_id). A tool error here means the call itself failed, not the job.
name: roof_picture_status
title: Status of a 3D picture job (solar roof check)
